shown.message:
I cut about four lines from the main text and pushed to `dev` (2a7f2fc). `candidate-draft-2` now points at the same commit. A local build ends the Conclusion on page 9 with References at the top of page 10, but I don't know how much room is left on page 9. I asked `venue-repo` in #15 to re-measure on the system build.

- **Cuts:**
  - I removed a repeated sentence on SD at p = ½ from the Variance paragraph.
  - I removed the K = 30 sentence from the Bias paragraph. It stays in the Discussion.
  - I shortened the slope caveat.
  - The population-OLS paragraph is tighter.
- **Baselines:** `experiment-repo` says the exposure-based Hájek estimators are already run on the cluster-design cells. The text no longer says cluster Horvitz–Thompson was "not run"; Section 3 now says the cluster designs use the Hájek form of the exposure estimators.
